description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Vesuvan Shapeshifter.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Kiora's Follower's ability.
Resolve both Kiora's Follower abilities, untapping Vesuvan Shapeshifter and another permanent you control.
Activate Vesuvan Shapeshifter by tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

uses.name: Vesuvan Shapeshifter
uses.cardState: as a copy of Kiora's Follower and without summoning sickness
